title: 第1183章 刘仪担忧第1182章 欺诈阵盘
slug: 开局一枚玉佩凡女低调修仙
lines: 萧玄看着调校完成的欺诈阵盘，眼中满是赞赏与激动。
诱捕猎物的诱饵已经准备就绪，接下来便是布置捕兽夹。
“宗主，诱饵已成。我们该将猎物引向何处？”
苏月一边服下回气丹药，一边出声询问。
萧玄走到大殿后方悬挂的门派地图前，伸出手指，点在主峰后山一处被标记为血红色的隐秘山谷上。
“禁闭谷。”萧玄的声音透着彻骨的寒意。
苏月目光顺着萧玄的手指看去。
禁闭谷乃是灵虚派用来关押犯下死罪的高阶修士之地。
那片山谷三面环山，岩石中蕴含着能够吸附灵气的特殊矿脉，天然具备隔绝外界探查的绝佳地理条件。
萧玄转过身，详细说出自己的布置。
“本座会在禁闭谷内，提前布置下门派传承的绝灵大阵。”
“此阵专为克制高阶修士而设，一旦启动，能够瞬间切断阵内之人与天地灵气的所有联系，并死死压制住其丹田内的元婴，使其无法调动半点真元。”
苏月点头，这确实是针对刘仪最完美的绝杀之地。
失去法力支撑的刘仪，便成了砧板上的鱼肉，任人宰割。
“接下来，我们只需找寻一个合理的借口，将刘仪调往禁闭谷。”
“待他踏入阵中，便立刻激活欺诈阵盘，发送逆流波动。”
“待其心神大乱、施法吸纳之际，本座便亲自开启绝灵大阵，将其镇压。”
萧玄将整个计划的各个环节串联起来，确认毫无纰漏。
两人的目光在昏暗的密室中交汇，一切尽在不言中。
夜幕再次降临。
萧玄换上一身玄色劲装，悄然离开密殿，独自潜往后山禁闭谷。
布置绝灵大阵需要耗费海量的布阵材料与高阶灵石，且必须由萧玄这位元婴后期大修士亲自主持，方能确保阵法威力达到压制元婴中期的效果。
苏月则留在密殿内部，静静地守在桌案前。
双眼注视着那块散发着微弱红光的欺天阵盘，双手捏紧法诀，随时准备按下激发阵法的致命按钮。
时间一点一滴地流逝。
次日正午，阳光透过大殿的窗棂洒在青石地砖上。
殿外传来近侍的通报声。
“禀宗主，刑罚堂刘长老求见。称已查明矿区守卫玩忽职守之罪，特来请示如何发落。”
萧玄早已从禁闭谷返回，端坐在宝座上。听到通报，萧玄嘴角勾起一抹冰冷的弧度。
鱼儿主动咬钩了。
“宣他进来。”萧玄沉声下令。
大门开启，刘仪手捧一卷玉简，神情肃穆地走入大殿。
“宗主，属下已将矿区失职人员全部缉拿。这是定罪名册，请宗主定夺。”
刘仪双手呈上玉简，展现出高效的办事能力。
萧玄接过玉简，随意扫了一眼，便将其扔在桌案上。
“刘长老办事，本座向来放心。”萧玄站起身，目光深邃地看着刘仪。
content_en:
Xiao Xuan looked at the completed deception array, his eyes full of admiration and excitement.
The bait to trap the prey is ready, and the next step is to set up the trap.
"Sect Master, the bait is ready. Where should we lead the prey?"
Su Yue asked aloud while taking the Qi-restoring elixir.
Xiao Xuan walked to the sect map hanging at the back of the hall, stretched out his finger, and pointed at a hidden valley marked in blood red on the mountain behind the main peak.
"Confinement Valley." Xiao Xuan's voice was filled with bone-chilling chill.
Su Yue followed Xiao Xuan's fingers.
The Valley of Confinement is a place used by the Lingxu Sect to imprison high-level monks who have committed capital crimes.
The valley is surrounded by mountains on three sides, and the rocks contain special mineral veins that can absorb spiritual energy. Naturally, it has excellent geographical conditions to isolate it from outside exploration.
Xiao Xuan turned around and explained his arrangement in detail.
"I will arrange the supreme spirit formation inherited from the sect in advance in the Forbidden Valley."
"This formation is specially designed to restrain high-level monks. Once activated, it can instantly cut off all connections between the people in the formation and the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, and suppress the Nascent Soul in their Dantian, making it impossible to mobilize any real energy."
Su Yue nodded, this was indeed the perfect place to kill Liu Yi.
Liu Yi, who lost the support of his magic power, became a piece of fish on the chopping board, ready to be slaughtered by others.
"Next, we just need to find a reasonable excuse to transfer Liu Yi to the Forbidden Valley."
"As soon as he steps into the formation, he will immediately activate the deception formation disk and send out countercurrent fluctuations."
"When his mind is in chaos and he casts spells to absorb him, I will personally activate the Jue Ling Formation to suppress him."
Xiao Xuan connected all the links of the entire plan and confirmed that there were no flaws.
The two people's eyes met in the dark secret room, and everything was unspoken.
Night falls again.
Xiao Xuan put on a black outfit, quietly left the secret hall, and sneaked alone into the Confinement Valley in the back mountain.
Setting up the Jueling Formation requires a large amount of formation materials and high-level spiritual stones, and must be personally presided over by Xiao Xuan, a late-stage Nascent Soul monk, in order to ensure that the power of the formation can achieve the effect of suppressing the mid-stage Nascent Soul.
Su Yue stayed inside the secret hall and stood quietly in front of the table.
His eyes were fixed on the Deception Formation Disk that emitted a faint red light, and he clenched the magic formula with both hands, ready to press the fatal button to activate the formation at any time.
Time passes bit by bit.
At noon the next day, the sun shone on the bluestone floor tiles through the window lattice of the main hall.
The announcement from the attendant came from outside the hall.
"Reporting to the sect leader, Elder Liu of the Punishment Hall is asking for an audience. He said that he has discovered the crime of neglect of duty by the guards in the mining area and is here to ask for instructions on how to deal with it."
Xiao Xuan had already returned from the Forbidden Valley and was sitting on the throne. Upon hearing the announcement, Xiao Xuan's lips curved into a cold arc.
The fish took the initiative to bite the hook.
"Inform him to come in." Xiao Xuan ordered in a deep voice.
The door opened, and Liu Yi walked into the hall solemnly, holding a jade slip in her hand.
"Sect Master, my subordinates have arrested all the delinquent personnel in the mining area. This is the list of convictions. Please make your decision, Sect Master."
Liu Yi presented the jade slip with both hands, showing her efficient work ability.
Xiao Xuan took the jade slip, glanced at it casually, and threw it on the table.
"Elder Liu, I always feel at ease when doing things." Xiao Xuan stood up and looked at Liu Yi deeply.
